question: Do extra features encode simple causal row-event rates, and how do they move when all book/trade inputs are quiet?
previous_evidence: E091 moderate a2/a3 correlation with book refresh rates; E280 simple instantaneous/age proxies did not identify a0..a4.
selection: 32 TRAIN canonical components distinct from prior small EDA memberships and from each other; first16fit and last16evaluation by fixed SHA ordering
rate_recurrence: r_t=exp2(-1/h)*r_(t-1)+(1-exp2(-1/h))*event_t; initial0; suppress all event flags at row0; include current event afterward. Events compare exact rawfloat32 block equality.
warmup: Compute on all rows but profile and rank only steps99..19999
selection_rule: One proxy per output, maximum pooled absolute Spearman on fitting inputs, no tuning beyond the fixed21choices
strong_rank_association_gate: Fitting sign fixed; sign-adjusted heldout Spearman>=0.95 on at least12/16components, retaining constant components as rho0. This establishes strong monotonic association only, not numeric rates or physical identity.
rank_method: Average ties, constant columns rho0, no dropping components
negative_controls: For each fixedselectedrate, compare its corresponding event row age and current stepindex without proxy selection. Report percomponent selected-rate correlations after removing exact rank-normal endpoint values; this is descriptive sensitivity, not additional selection or a relaxed gate.
descriptive_profiles: Quiet means no p/v/dp/dv change for either instrument at the current row. Count positive/zero/negative a0..a7 changes on quiet versus refresh rows, tied distinct values and known rank-normal endpoints; no thresholds selected from these counts
resource_limit: Foreground only, one thread pool worker, <=2GiB address space, <=60sCPU and wall perphase; not a systemd/cgroup/durable claim
